name: basic-3d
label: Incanto 3D Empty Stage Template
description: Incanto engine 3D empty stage (Three.js underneath, the whole game is scene JSON): a solid ground under a physical sky, a shadow-casting sun, a marker cube and a camera framing the origin — no character. Pick this for a 3D game that is not a character game: puzzle, board game, tower defense, idle, tycoon, simulation, sandbox. The project uses the incanto-* skills — read incanto-your-first-game before the first edit. 3D only; not for 2D games.
